name: Kusushi
source:
A Kusushi type monster girl. Kusushi means 'doctor' and Kusushis are healers and herbalist monster girls. This Kusushi is a friend of [url=http://vndb.org/c10475]Vanilla[/url] and the two lead a rebellion against [url=http://vndb.org/c13604]Baron Squid[/url]. She helps out by selling medicines and items and later on works in battle as a healer and support.

She takes care of monster girls which [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] makes pregnant to make sure their eggs are delivered safely.
